task.title: Add parallel agents to festina-finalize for docs phase
task.description: Refactor festina-finalize skill to use parallel agents for product and engineering documentation updates. The festina-finalize skill (in apps/festinalente) currently handles checks, product docs, engineering docs, and git operations all in a single context, leading to high cognitive load and sequential execution.
task.problem: The festina-finalize skill handles checks, product docs, engineering docs, and git operations all in a single context. This leads to: - High cognitive load for the LLM - Slower execution (sequential doc updates) - Higher risk of errors in complex tasks
task.value: - Faster execution (product + engineering docs run in parallel) - Better reliability (each agent has focused context with just its reference file) - Reduced main context usage (agents do heavy lifting, return summaries) - Follows proven patterns from festina-scope and industry best practices
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given a task with both affects and engineering fields When running /festina-finalize Then Phase 2 spawns Product Docs Agent AND Engineering Docs Agent in parallel
Given Phase 2 agents complete successfully When orchestrator receives their results Then it commits all doc changes in a single commit
Given a task with only affects (no engineering) When running /festina-finalize Then only Product Docs Agent is spawned (no unnecessary parallelism)
Given an agent encounters an error When it cannot complete its work Then it returns error details to orchestrator for user decision
task.notes:
Context: - festina-scope already uses 4 parallel agents for Deep research mode - Product docs and engineering docs touch different directories - safe to parallelize - Research confirms: parallel execution works when agents touch different files - Agent prompts must include full context (agents don't inherit conversation history) - Orchestrator should commit all changes together for cleaner git history
Technical Notes: - Each agent loads its reference file (docs-product.md or docs-engineering.md) - Each agent receives: taskId, title, doc IDs categorized, acceptance criteria, smart context - Agents return: files changed (paths), summary of updates, any validation errors - Phase 1 (checks) and Phase 3 (complete) remain in orchestrator - sequential/interactive - File location: apps/festinalente (not .claude/skills)
